Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionStrike at the heart of the Nazi regime East Prussia, 1944. Behind concrete, barbed wire and heavily armed security rings lies one of the most dangerous places of the Second World War: the Wolf’s Lair – the sealed-off power centre of the Nazi leadership. As an elite soldier, you fight through heavily guarded facilities, defensive positions and bunkers. Every advance is brutal, direct and fast-paced. Short, hard firefights await you, where every explosion blasts open a path and every hit brings you closer to the key figures of the dictatorship – up to the final showdown with Hitler himself. • Experience compact missions with intense firefights and uncompromising action. • Use a deadly arsenal of weapons, explosives, vehicles and mounted guns. • Target high-ranking officers and generals – all the way to Hitler. • Immerse yourself in the era with historical uniforms, flags and symbols. • Storm the Wolf’s Lair – precisely reconstructed using original plans and current satellite data.Show morePublished byMarkt+Technik Verlag GmbHDeveloped byPolygon ArtRelease date10/15/2026Play withXBOX Series X|SCapabilities4K Ultra HDSingle playerRay Tracing60 fps+Optimized for Xbox Series X|SXbox achievementsXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
